note: Both sets repeat the same core dishwasher and clothes-dryer scoring facts, and both share a few flaws (the bracketed chart quotes, the garbled "one wash and rinse and cycle" quote, and the misbound claim that 48.9 °C is the half-points threshold). Set A adds two clear errors the source does not support: an invented 8-hour clothes-drying cycle duration (from "Contest 8-3h"/"8-5") and a misreading of the chart's 90–120 x-axis tick values as points. Set B instead adds several correct, distinct claims A misses (heated drying option must be disabled, allowable drying methods, automatic operation), while its own errors are milder (a mislabeled "minimum temperature" and a 115 °F claim that drops the half-points condition).
